fields.description: River Cove Residences is Sobha City’s waterfront apartment collection in Abu Dhabi. The newer official brochure shows three towers, with one- and two-bedroom homes alongside larger Tower C apartments and a four-bedroom duplex. Waterfront walks and shared community spaces shape the setting beyond the individual home.

overview: The July brochure extends the mix beyond the webpage’s Tower A/B examples. Tower C includes a three-bedroom Type A with a yard and a four-bedroom Type A duplex across levels 8 and 9. Large external areas are included in their published totals, so these figures are not all enclosed living space.
research.locationNote: Within Sobha City, Abu Dhabi. Property Finder places the collection in Al Bahya, also written Al Bahia. Confirm the exact villa plot or tower position on its own approved plan; community travel times are not unit-specific measurements.
research.priceNote: Property Finder displays an approximately AED 1.4m launch reference, while some of its linked collection cards retain AED 1.35m. No current starting-price panel was found on the dedicated developer page. The displayed amount is an attributed rounded launch guide, not an available-unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% at launch, 40% during construction and 40% on handover. No dated developer-issued schedule was located in the project page or reviewed brochure. This is an attributed launch reference; obtain the current instalments, fees and deadlines in writing.
research.handoverNote: Sobha’s 4M FY26 investor update, dated to 30 April 2026, forecasts handover in 2029. Property Finder specifies December 2029; no unit-specific dated developer schedule was located. The year is a forecast, not a completion guarantee.
